_description: AGV EVO unit 01 (ex AGV B / TN) — CAN-BLDC towing AGV, pusher actuator and lidar

networking._comment: LOCAL_IP is a placeholder — verify the PC address before deploy. The 192.168.1.x AO subnet is gone (wheels are on CANopen now).

motor_can._comment: BLVD-KRD CiA-402 wheel drives. CHANNEL is the slcan device on the Ubuntu vehicle (e.g. /dev/ttyACM0); set null to auto-detect the CANable2. EDS resolves under can_bldc/. Provisional ramps/ceiling — tune on vehicle.

pusher_channels._comment: DO channel indices for the double-acting electric linear actuator

horn_channels._comment: Dedicated DO channel indices for the horns. regular_horn = steady ON in auto (running/reverse); alarm_horn = steady ON instead when an alarm is active.

speeds._comment_manual_accel: Manual jog acceleration in m/s^2. Applies on button press only; release = instant stop (no deceleration). Set to 2x ACCEL_RATE so manual feels more responsive than auto.

pid_tuning._comment_high: 2026-05-12: DT halved to 50ms (sensor TPDO1 now at 100Hz). KP=2.4, TD=0.13 with N=2 filter (alpha~0.43 at DT=50ms).
pid_tuning._comment_slow: SLOW: KP and TD slightly milder than HIGH; N=2 to match HIGH filter strength.
pid_tuning._comment_shared: Integral ENABLED — deadband-gated (|e|<5mm) removes steady bias on straights. TI_MAX caps i_term contribution to ~66 rpm.
pid_tuning._comment_sr: Speed reduction — deep SR_CAP (50%) and high V_RED_COEF needed because wheels are forward-only. SR_ALPHA=0.1 preserves ~0.5s time constant at DT=50ms.

can_sensor._comment: SICK MLS magnetic line sensor (CANopen). TPDO1 COB-ID = 0x180 + CAN_NODE_ID (0x18A for node 0x0A). The sensor must be pre-configured (SICK MLS config tool / LSS) to this NODE_ID and 500 kbit/s to share the BLDC bus — bitrate is NOT set from here. Steering follows LCP2 (the centre line for a single track).

sequences._comment: Tag 10 ARRIVAL — AGV arrives at home: stop, pusher DOWN, set at_home, return to ARMED
sequences.name: tag10

sequences._comment: Tag 10 DEPARTURE — AGV starts from home: stop, pusher UP (5s), clear at_home, resume HIGH
sequences.name: tag10

sequences._comment: Tag 20 — slow speed for corners and sequence approaches
sequences.name: tag20_slow

sequences._comment: Tag 30 — resume HIGH speed on straights
sequences.name: tag30_high

sequences._comment: Tag 40 — stop, pusher DOWN (5s), resume at current speed
sequences.name: tag40_pusher_down

sequences._comment: Tag 50 — stop, pusher UP (5s), resume at current speed
sequences.name: tag50_pusher_up

features._comment: Set any hardware flag to 0 to run without that device connected (no connect errors). The SICK MLS (CAN_ENABLED) shares the wheel-drive bus, so it needs MOTOR_CAN_ENABLED on too. LIDAR_STOP_ENABLED is driven by the runtime UI toggle (defaults ON at boot regardless of this value); kept here only as a deployment hint.
